firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support a personalized micro-learning platform. It emphasizes authorization independence and efficient data retrieval for user dashboards.  User data and related information (progress, scores, achievements) are stored under the `/users/{userId}` path to enforce ownership. Learning content (topics, lessons, quizzes) is stored in separate collections to facilitate easier management and querying. Authorization independence is achieved by storing all data relevant to a user directly under their user ID path, eliminating the need for `get()` calls to parent documents for authorization checks. This structure enables atomic operations and simplifies security rules. The structure also supports QAPs by using path-based ownership for private data and dedicated collections for learning content, which prevents rules from acting as filters during list operations. No custom claims are needed as roles are not used in this design.
